expected: Open the APP-equivalent search Screen with query, history, location and category filters.
actual: Mini only calls wx.showToast with 搜索暂未开放.
acceptanceCriteria: Mini implements the complete search state graph and returns to the prior wardrobe state.

expected: Open the APP statistics Screen with overview, recent, idle and purchase-usage sections.
actual: Mini only displays a toast summary and has no registered statistics page.
acceptanceCriteria: Mini exposes all APP statistics sections with empty and populated states.

expected: Long press enters multi-select with toggle, cancel and confirmed bulk deletion.
actual: Mini catalog card exposes tap/select only and has no multi-select state.
acceptanceCriteria: Mini supports APP-equivalent multi-selection and server-verified bulk deletion.

expected: Use the APP three-dot action menu with edit, move and delete.
actual: Mini renders four inline actions, omits move and adds detail-level rerecognize.
acceptanceCriteria: Mini action hierarchy and actions match the APP semantic model.

expected: Inspiration references and pairing tabs contain real content, add/preview and outfit navigation.
actual: Mini tabs contain static empty copy and the visible add tile has no action.
acceptanceCriteria: Mini implements real inspiration and pairing content with the same operations.

expected: Toggle today's wear and preview hero/reference images.
actual: Mini has neither the wear action nor image preview handlers.
acceptanceCriteria: Mini supports server-verified wear toggling and image preview/close.

expected: Visible crop and rerecognize buttons execute their workflows.
actual: Mini buttons are rendered without bindtap and handlers do not exist.
acceptanceCriteria: Both controls have stable IDs and complete success/failure/cancel behavior.

expected: Transparent APP-style back control outside the capsule mask.
actual: Mini back control has a white circular background.
acceptanceCriteria: Back icon has no APP-absent white container and preserves the capsule safe region.

expected: Derive capsule geometry from wx.getMenuButtonBoundingClientRect.
actual: Detail shell uses fixed grid and right padding without runtime capsule geometry.
acceptanceCriteria: Header reserves only the runtime capsule rectangle plus approved padding.

expected: Deletion cascade copy states one authoritative outcome.
actual: APP says related outfit item is removed; mini says outfit may remain but item is hidden.
acceptanceCriteria: Both clients use copy matching the verified server cascade.

expected: Expose loading, collapsed, expanded, error, retry, close and regenerate states.
actual: Mini exposes loading, summary and tips only; failures are toast-only.
acceptanceCriteria: Mini implements all APP diagnosis states and transitions.

expected: User sees APP-equivalent source/result thumbnails and confirms interactive crop, rotation and reset before recognition and save.
actual: Verified on the latest real-device preview: Android gallery selection opened the crop page, rotate changed the visible result, confirmation returned a processed thumbnail, original/thumbnail temporary assets both reached ready, and garment 4fe34293-24c6-4df9-a6e3-aefe6086d06b saved with both variants in server readback.
acceptanceCriteria: Mini implements APP-equivalent crop/rotate/reset/cancel/confirm and visibly distinguishes source and processed thumbnails on the latest real-device preview before permanent upload.

expected: Keep images in page memory until crop and explicit business submission.
actual: Fixed in mini repair branch: selection remains a tempFilePath and USER_DATA_PATH copying was removed; runtime filesystem proof pending.
acceptanceCriteria: Mini upload order matches the approved image-session then explicit-save contract.

expected: Remove one selected image without clearing the batch.
actual: Mini only exposes clearSelected for the whole queue.
acceptanceCriteria: Each selected image can be removed independently with count updates.

expected: Confirm whether to save completed drafts when other drafts remain unfinished.
actual: Mini has no partial-save decision state.
acceptanceCriteria: Mini preserves unfinished drafts and submits only explicitly selected completed drafts.

expected: Permanent permission denial explains how to restore access in system settings.
actual: Mini returns generic 选择图片失败 copy.
acceptanceCriteria: Mini distinguishes cancel, temporary denial and permanent denial with recovery action.

expected: Cancel or clear abandons every uploaded temporary asset session.
actual: Mini clears the memory queue but does not retain or DELETE sessionId.
acceptanceCriteria: Cancel and clear leave no unbound temporary asset session beyond the tested cleanup policy.

expected: Every rejected batch save clears saving and presents retained failed drafts.
actual: saveAll has no top-level try/finally; a rejected batch promise may leave saving=true.
acceptanceCriteria: Fault injection proves saving always clears and retry preserves the same mutation IDs.

expected: Visible recrop and rerecognize controls execute complete workflows.
actual: Fixed in mini repair branch with bound crop/upload/readback and AI-to-memory-draft flows; live media verification pending.
acceptanceCriteria: Both actions work with loading, failure, retry and draft preservation.

expected: Show confirmation and allow selecting a target wardrobe before conversion.
actual: Verified in the repaired mini runtime: the conversion sheet loaded the real default closet, required the selected location, committed revision 2/4 purchased records and returned converted garment references.
acceptanceCriteria: Mini confirms conversion, selects any valid location and verifies the created garment readback.

expected: Warn and confirm before deleting the converted garment and related references.
actual: Verified in the repaired mini runtime: cancel kept revision 4 and the converted garment reference unchanged; confirm advanced to revision 5, cleared converted references and PostgreSQL showed the converted garment soft-deleted.
acceptanceCriteria: Mini has cancel/confirm paths and cancel produces zero server writes.

expected: Explain and protect the state where the converted garment was already deleted.
actual: Mini offers togglePurchase based only on wishlist status and falls back to generic API errors.
acceptanceCriteria: Mini shows the deleted-link notice and disables invalid undo operations.

expected: Expose APP assessment filters and real pairing/similar-item content.
actual: Mini uses business status filters and static empty pairing copy.
acceptanceCriteria: Mini implements the APP assessment and pairing semantics.

expected: Archive directly and open a valid converted garment from detail.
actual: Mini detail exposes neither action.
acceptanceCriteria: Mini provides both actions with authoritative readback.

expected: Back from a dirty form opens discard/continue confirmation.
actual: Mini has no dirty snapshot or unload/back interception.
acceptanceCriteria: System and page back preserve or explicitly discard edits.

expected: A 409 conflict preserves edits and offers refresh/retry guidance.
actual: Mini only shows a generic toast and clears saving.
acceptanceCriteria: Mini exposes a dedicated conflict state without losing the draft.

expected: Await repository deletion with the complete entity and only report success after readback.
actual: Verified on MEIZU 21 Pro with APK 5a9aba5: plan deletion completed after revision refresh and the server overview no longer contained the trip.
acceptanceCriteria: Deletion uses the complete server entity, awaits committed status and verifies absence.

expected: Await deletion with the complete OutfitPlanEntry and verify absence.
actual: Verified on MEIZU 21 Pro with APK 5a9aba5: the day entry was absent after deletion while the canonical manual packing item remained in server readback.
acceptanceCriteria: Calendar entry deletion is committed and verified before success UI.

expected: Checklist toggle/add/all/reset writes persist through the checklist API and readback.
actual: Verified on MEIZU 21 Pro with APK 5a9aba5: toggle, add, mark-all and reset completed; after force-stop the custom item remained and every item was unchecked in server readback.
acceptanceCriteria: Every checklist mutation persists and survives force-stop/refetch.

expected: Render cancel-worn for an actually worn entry, call cancel-worn with dateKey then outfitId, and refresh server state.
actual: Verified on MEIZU 21 Pro with fixed APK 201a066: the calendar card rendered 取消已穿; activation restored the plan to planned, removed the date from outfit wornDates and removed the same-day wear-event.
acceptanceCriteria: Cancel-worn sends correct identifiers and reverses wear/plan state consistently.

expected: Functional packing list with toggle, manual items, mark-all and reset.
actual: Verified in the repaired mini runtime: toggle, manual quantity-2 item, mark-all and reset advanced revisions 2 through 5; after relaunch/relogin the server readback retained the manual item, total 4 and packed count 0.
acceptanceCriteria: Mini implements the complete server-backed packing workflow.

expected: Every registered business route is functional or removed from the product inventory.
actual: Mini trips/index is a placeholder with no normal navigation entry.
acceptanceCriteria: The route is implemented and mapped or removed from app.json with affected navigation verified.

expected: APP-equivalent tabs, real-photo lifecycle and replacement suggestions.
actual: Mini exposes a single summary page without those flows.
acceptanceCriteria: Mini detail contains all APP semantic sections and operations.

expected: APP-equivalent multi-step metadata and garment confirmation flow.
actual: Mini uses a reduced single-page name, AI and garment selection flow.
acceptanceCriteria: Mini preserves APP fields, confirmation sequence and failure states.

expected: Create a diagnostic case, upload sanitized content, verify checksum and show success/failure/retry.
actual: Verified in the repaired mini runtime: POST create and PUT content both returned 200, UI reached success with case ID, and PostgreSQL readback matched uploaded status, checksum, size and workspace counts.
acceptanceCriteria: Mini completes the same create/upload/readback lifecycle and privacy checks.

expected: Logout revokes the current server session and then clears local state.
actual: Verified in the repaired mini runtime: POST logout succeeded with an explicit empty JSON body, local session cleared only afterward, and the captured old token returned 401 from workspace overview without being output or persisted.
acceptanceCriteria: After logout, the captured old token receives 401 from workspace overview.

expected: Display the locked package version.
actual: Mini hardcodes 2.1.8-test while the baseline package version is 2.1.13-test.
acceptanceCriteria: About version derives from a single build source and equals package version.

expected: Edit and persist the APP wear profile.
actual: Mini settings shows placeholder copy only.
acceptanceCriteria: Mini implements all profile fields and server readback.

expected: Enable, upload, crop, preview and delete reference photos.
actual: Mini displays a disabled placeholder.
acceptanceCriteria: Mini implements the complete user-triggered reference photo lifecycle.

expected: Agreement content and last-updated date match APP.
actual: Mini uses older abbreviated 2026-07-08 local terms.
acceptanceCriteria: Both platforms render the same approved sections and date.

expected: Privacy disclosure accurately states MiniMax Key storage.
actual: Mini privacy says the app does not save the key while the AI settings service uses wx.setStorageSync.
acceptanceCriteria: Privacy copy matches actual local storage and transmission behavior.

expected: Login/session restoration semantics match the APP after process restart.
actual: Mini session store is runtime memory only and is expected to log out after process restart.
acceptanceCriteria: Restart behavior is explicitly matched or approved and tested without persisting business data.

expected: Every authenticated GET 401 clears session and returns to login.
actual: workspace GET bypasses the common HTTP 401 session-clear path.
acceptanceCriteria: All authenticated requests share the same 401 recovery behavior.

expected: A long-running crop and edit flow survives access-token expiry by refreshing once and retrying the pending authenticated request without losing the draft.
actual: Fixed by mini commits c108c7f and 026b0ad. Before repair, the real phone uploaded original/thumbnail assets but final wishlist create returned Invalid access token after roughly 20 minutes. After repair, CLI injected an invalid access token with a real valid refresh token; production workspace overview succeeded after access/refresh rotation, future expiry restoration and one request replay.
acceptanceCriteria: JSON, wx.uploadFile and binary temporary-asset PUT requests share one refresh mutex, retry at most once, and clear the session only when refresh or the replay fails.

expected: Diagnostic request traces are linked only when requestId, user and device ownership match.
actual: Fixed in the repair branch: linkRequestTraces now requires requestId, userIdHash and deviceIdHash equality; cross-user/device integration verification remains pending.
acceptanceCriteria: Cross-user/device requestId collisions cannot attach traces to another diagnostic case and regression tests prove it.

expected: npm run test:env:reset performs guarded, complete test-data cleanup.
actual: Fixed in the repair branch: the npm command now invokes the guarded API reset CLI; real execute and teardown verification remain pending.
acceptanceCriteria: Reset is test-environment allowlisted, complete, auditable and verified by before/after counts.

expected: The real reset covers every current user/auth/workspace/diagnostic/asset table.
actual: Fixed in the repair branch: all 32 schema tables are enumerated and a schema-derived regression test enforces exact coverage; execute verification remains pending.
acceptanceCriteria: Schema-derived coverage proves no user-test rows remain after reset.

expected: Test cleanup obeys the project trash-only deletion policy.
actual: Fixed in the repair branch: schema teardown uses argument-safe psql and storage cleanup moves the explicit directory through trash, failing closed when unavailable.
acceptanceCriteria: No project-owned cleanup path uses recursive force deletion.

expected: Release reporting validates case-level evidence, screenshots and final gates.
actual: Several adapters are NOT_RUN stubs, aggregate results collapse suites to passed=1 and final gate is not implemented.
acceptanceCriteria: Parity reporting emits schema-valid case-level coverage, defects, JUnit and evidence-complete gates.

expected: Mini intake temporary files are removed after cancel, clear and completed save.
actual: Images are copied under USER_DATA_PATH/intake and no explicit cleanup path was found.
acceptanceCriteria: Runtime filesystem evidence proves temporary files are deleted at every terminal path.

expected: Android API client retains the requested deviceId and sends it on every authenticated request.
actual: Verified on the real Android device: smoke and critical authenticated workspace requests passed with the requested deviceId retained in session.
acceptanceCriteria: Android authenticated requests carry the exact registered deviceId and pass asset/workspace device checks.

expected: Temporary asset session and entity create use the same clientMutationId required by the server binding contract.
actual: Verified on the real Android device: original/thumbnail assets bound successfully, survived restart and followed wishlist conversion without weakening the server contract.
acceptanceCriteria: Image E2E uploads bind successfully and verify original/thumbnail readback without weakening the server contract.

expected: Deleting a garment atomically removes all garment UUID and legacy item-id references while retaining unrelated items and purchase history.
actual: Fixed and verified on the real Android device: outfit, outfit-plan, converted wishlist and wear-event references are cleaned in the same mutation transaction; unaffected records remain.
acceptanceCriteria: Unit tests and real APK readback prove no active entity references the deleted garment UUID or legacy item id.

expected: The Android navigation-bar area continues the approved app ambient background and does not create a pure-white strip below pages.
actual: On MEIZU 21 Pro / Android 16 the navigation bar is visible at 88 physical pixels with a pure-white background while the page ends in the mist ambient gradient; the mismatch is visible across calendar and plan-detail screenshots.
acceptanceCriteria: Fresh-install and in-app screenshots show no color seam at the bottom system gesture area on the real device, with the gesture handle remaining legible.

expected: Arbitrarily long outfit names truncate inside their card without changing the viewport width; add controls and bottom navigation remain fully visible.
actual: Verified on MEIZU 21 Pro with APK 0330ec0 and a 200+ character outfit name: innerWidth, document scrollWidth and body scrollWidth were all 390; +计划 ended at x=374, global create at x=370 and bottom navigation spanned x=16..374.
acceptanceCriteria: A 200+ character outfit name keeps document and body scrollWidth within innerWidth and leaves +计划, global create and bottom navigation inside the viewport on the real Android device.

expected: APP silently refreshes a server-rejected access token and replays the original workspace or AI request once.
actual: A still-locally-fresh access token rejected by the server surfaces Invalid access token and interrupts normal flows.
acceptanceCriteria: Workspace and AI requests recover through one refresh mutex without showing Invalid access token or losing the current draft.

expected: Authorized APP and mini devices remain signed in through process death and rolling refresh until explicit revocation.
actual: The formal mini baseline returns to the login page after WeChat is force-stopped and the recent mini program is reopened.
acceptanceCriteria: APP and mini survive process death and a 31-day time advance; only logout, device/all-device revoke, deletion or replay/theft revocation clears the device session.

expected: Every mini root page has exactly one stable bottom navigation bar.
actual: After switching root tabs on the real phone, the custom tab bar and WeChat native tab bar render simultaneously and change click geometry.
acceptanceCriteria: Four root tabs and twenty repeated current-tab taps keep exactly one bottom bar with no duplicated page stack.

expected: All approved navigation and action icons remain visible on a real WeChat device.
actual: Root tab icons are absent on the real phone because the CSS SVG mask approach does not render reliably.
acceptanceCriteria: Local normal and selected PNG icons are visible on every root tab and audited action surface.

expected: Mini intake step 1 matches the APP large preview, thumbnails and append/edit/remove/clear/next structure.
actual: Mini selection and crop entry are structurally different and do not provide the approved step-1 review workspace.
acceptanceCriteria: Single and multi-image garment and wishlist intake follow the approved step-1 structure on the real phone.

expected: Recognition remains in step 1 and enters step 2 once after all selected images settle.
actual: Mini uses separate selection, recognition review and result navigation that diverge from the approved two-step state machine.
acceptanceCriteria: Recognition progress, success, partial failure, retry and exit paths match the approved state graph.

expected: Successful save returns directly to the source catalog; partial failures remain in step 2.
actual: Fixed in the mini repair branch: the result route is unregistered, successful save returns to the source catalog and partial failures stay in review.
acceptanceCriteria: No legal navigation enters an extra result page and save/partial failure paths match the APP.

expected: APP intake headers remain below the Android status bar and camera cutout on every entry/resume path.
actual: The intake header can render beneath the Android status bar or front-camera area.
acceptanceCriteria: Cold start, home entry, gallery return and background resume all consume real window insets without fixed-device padding.

expected: Settings contains only user-facing product information and actions.
actual: Settings displays a developer implementation note about backend AI proxy and future integrations.
acceptanceCriteria: The entire developer note is removed without replacement technical copy.

expected: Mini detail fields match APP visibility rules and temperature range semantics.
actual: Auxiliary color is shown in unsupported color modes and the APP temperature interval bar is absent.
acceptanceCriteria: Auxiliary color appears only in primary-plus-secondary mode and the readable APP-equivalent temperature bar is rendered.

expected: The recommendation route implements the approved APP-equivalent generation flow.
actual: The registered mini recommendation page is an unnumbered placeholder.
acceptanceCriteria: Recommendation input, loading, result, retry, refresh and result actions are implemented and tested.

expected: The try-on route implements the user-triggered reference and garment image lifecycle.
actual: The registered mini try-on page is an unnumbered placeholder.
acceptanceCriteria: Crop, confirm, generation, retry, preview, save and delete are implemented with explicit user image consent.
